" We need you to report to Area 51 as soon as possible! When you are ready for transport, I will contact you as soon as we are able to teleport you in." — Martian Manhunter  " Brainiac is attacking Area 51 for the green kryptonite the US government and Cadmus is researching there. Or rather, Lex is researching, since only green kryptonite can kill Superman. You must protect that Kryptonite from Brainiac! Tell me when you are ready for transport. I will contact you when the teleport is ready." — Talia al Ghul Alert T1: Area 51 is a level 30 mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the first of the two introductory missions to the Area 51 alert.

" This is Oracle. Scarecrow, Mister Freeze, and Poison Ivy were all locked in Arkham, but they've broken out and taken over the place! Batman wants you to get a group together and meet him there." — Oracle Alert T1: Arkham Asylum is a level 30 hero mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the introductory mission to the Arkham Asylum alert.

" Feeling a little crazi-er than usual? Scarecrow, Poison Ivy, and Mister Freeze have taken over Arkham Asylum, and Joker's not laughing. Guess he feels a little territorial about the place. Get your group ready and head out to Arkham." — Calculator Alert T1: Arkham Asylum is a level 30 villain mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the introductory mission to the Arkham Asylum alert.

" This is the Martian Manhunter, and I have a global Justice League alert. The Society has detonated Chemo, a living chemical weapon, over the city of Bludhaven near Gotham. The area is a toxic nightmare, completely beyond normal emergency personnel. Worse, Chemo cannot die. He must be contained before his pollution spreads! Respond now to this Global alert!" — Martian Manhunter  " This is Talia with an urgent Society alert. We have successfully detonated Chemo over Bludhaven! The city is now a toxic wreck, ripe for our exploitation. Your mission now is to retrieve Chemo. He's far too valuable to abandon, and no ordinary human can possibly contain him. Respond now!" — Talia al Ghul Alert T1: Blüdhaven is a level 30 mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the first of the two introductory missions to the Blüdhaven alert.

Alert T1: Coast City is a level 30 villain mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the first of the two introductory missions to the Coast City alert.

" Greetings. This is the Martian Manhunter with a Justice League alert at Gorilla Island. It is the source of the alien technology used by Gorilla Grodd, and now the Ultra-Humanite has attacked to make it his own. He is threatening to turn the world into his Ultra-Gorillas unless we pay his ransom. The Justice League believes we have a better way to deal with this threat. You." — Martian Manhunter  " This is Talia al Ghul, with a Global Society Alert. The Ultra-Humanite has taken over Gorilla Island, the source of Gorilla Grodd's devolution technology, and is now threatening to turn the world into his Ultra-Apes... unless we pay. No one extorts money from the Society! He must be punished." — Talia al Ghul Alert T1: Gorilla Island is a level 30 hero mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the first of the two introductory missions to the Gorilla Island alert.

" Queen Bee and Brainiac are in league to plunder Exobytes embedded in the moon's surface, and their mining threatens to split the moon in half. Respond immediately for teleport." — Martian Manhunter  " This is Talia al Ghul. I assign Society's urgent Alerts. We have an extreme situation developing on the moon. The HIVE is allied with Brainiac to mine Exobytes from the moon, and their idiot methods may crack the moon in two. Respond now and prepare to teleport." — Talia al Ghul Alert T1: HIVE Moon Base is a level 30 mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. " This is Talia al Ghul. The Demon's Head, leader of the League of Assassins, is Ra's al Ghul. My father. As much as I respect him, his latest plans threaten the very existence of the League. I will aid you against him where I can. This must be concluded before my beloved, the Batman, himself becomes involved. But warned, our ninjas are the spirit of death itself. And Ra's is guarded by the most fearsome of all: the Claws of the Demon." — Talia al Ghul Alert T1: League of Assassins Stronghold is a level 30 mission for both heroes and villains unlocked by completing the Lady In Waiting mission. It's the second of the two introductory missions to the League of Assassins Stronghold alert.

" It's Oracle. I just received a transmission from Lantern Gardner on Oa. He wants all Corps deputies to "get their rookie butts to the Sciencells." Sounds like there's trouble with the inmates. " It's Calculator. Sinestro has sent out a call for all Corps... deputies... to report to the Sciencells on Oa immediately. Sounds like he's staging some sort of prison break. " I am the Martian Manhunter. There is a Global Alert on the island nation of Oolong. The mad scientists who make the island their home have created tools far beyond their control. It's the first of the two introductory missions to the Oolong Island alert.

" This is Oracle. I'm picking up a considerable amount of activity from inside one of the larger bottles. It's the Gotham Courthouse. Preliminary scans show it could be the epicenter of Brainiac's reprogramming pipeline. Head there now. Once inside I'll use your comm frequency to gather more intel." — Oracle  " Oracle got you inside...good. This bottle is the command center for the leaders of Brainiac's so-called Union. Inside here, the governing members reprogram converted civilians, assigning them their civic duties. They've constructed graviton emitters from scraps of Brainiac technology. To reach the Union leaders you'll need to disable them. Taking this place out will disrupt their work." — Batman  " Calculator here. I've been scanning the larger bottles and it seems that "court" is in session. There's quite a lot of activity around Gotham Courthouse. It could be the center of Brainiac's reprogramming system. Head there now. I'll take additional readings inside." — Calculator  " You've broken the bottle. Excellent. Destroy anyone inside. This is the center of Brainiac's reprogramming efforts. An attack on this command center should cripple his plans and set me- us- up for our next move." — Lex Luthor Alert T1: South Gotham Courthouse is a level 30 hero mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the introductory mission to the South Gotham Courthouse alert.

" Oracle here. We've got a serious situation down at STAR Labs' main facility in Metropolis. Their scientists have been using technology to harness the powers of emotions. Brainiac found out and is co-opting the tech for his own use. The Green Lanterns think this may be causing malfunctions in their rings and have called a temporary truce with the Sinestro Corps to stop Brainiac. Queue up for STAR Labs in your communicator and I'll contact you once there!" — Oracle  " It's your friend Calculator. STAR Labs in Metropolis is in distress, and gee - we wouldn't want those guys to face peril alone, would we? Their scientists have been harnessing the powers of emotions and Brainiac has stepped in to hijack their work. The Sinestro Corps thinks this may be causing their rings to malfunction. They've even called a truce with the Green Lanterns to stop Brainiac. Queue up for STAR Labs in your communicator and I'll contact you onsite." — Calculator Alert T1: STAR Labs Research Facility is a level 30 hero mission unlocked by completing the Further Crises Pt. 1 mission. It's the introductory mission to the STAR Labs Research Facility alert.

" Stryker's is a war zone! A riot started just as the Rogues arrived in lockup. " We've got a riot at Stryker's. Ordinarily, who cares? But since the Rogues just went into lockup, this might be the perfect opportunity to break them out. It's the introductory mission to the Stryker's Island Penitentiary alert.

" Good news. We've synthesized more of the Probiotic counteragent. These temporary inoculations will allow you to get close to Doomsday without being too harmed by his spores.
